title: One AI chatbot plug-in leaked 700+ companies

beats.say: One AI chatbot plug in leaked data from over seven hundred companies. The chat wasn't the problem. The connection was.

vis.title: Drift AI chat · connected to Salesforce

beats.say: In August 2025, a group Google tracks as UNC6395 used stolen OAuth tokens from the Salesloft Drift chat agent. They exported Salesforce data. Google counted over seven hundred potentially affected organizations.

items: activity seen at least this long

beats.say: And they weren't after the chats. They searched the exported data for AWS keys, passwords and Snowflake tokens.
So treat every AI tool you connect as a key to your data. Audit them, revoke the ones you don't use, and never store secrets in your CRM.

vis.title: Your checklist
rows: every AI tool with OAuth access
rotate keys stored in that data

beats.say: Here's the prompt. Screenshot it, and send it to Claude inside your project.
Follow Ship With Pip for one of these every day.

prompt: Help me audit every third-party app and AI tool connected to my accounts (Google, GitHub, Slack, Salesforce or other CRM, Notion). List each OAuth connection, what it can access, and which ones I should revoke. Then check my CRM and docs for pasted API keys or passwords, and tell me what to rotate.
caption: In Aug 2025, Google tracked a group (UNC6395) using stolen OAuth tokens from the Salesloft Drift AI chat agent to export Salesforce data. Google counted 700+ potentially impacted organizations, and the attackers searched the data for AWS keys, passwords and Snowflake tokens. Treat every connected AI tool as a key to your data: audit, revoke, rotate. The prompt is at the end. Building your own app? Use code AT100 on Base44 (link in bio).
sources: The Hacker News (Aug 2025): Salesloft Drift OAuth breach, UNC6395, Aug 8-18 2025, 700+ potentially impacted orgs per GTIG, AWS keys/passwords/Snowflake tokens searched
